hook: You don't have a reading problem. You have a keeping problem.
promise: Five keepable ideas from The Commonplace Book by A. Reader — then a practice you can do tonight.

acts.name: The leak
beats: You don't have a reading problem. You have a keeping problem.
The ideas leaked because nothing in the week asked you to use them
If you cannot say it, you did not keep it

acts.name: The practice
beats: Remember this: the book is not finished when you close it
Rather than paint the page yellow, write the idea in your own words
If you cannot write it, you do not own it yet

acts.name: The shelf
beats: Ask of every mark: would I teach this to a friend at a table?
Write the sentence as if you had to send it in a letter
Don't just read. Build ideas. https://albuc.com

ctaLine: Keep the book in Albuc. Don't just read. Build ideas.
